service.name: Voice and video service
service.hint: The service module that carries the call for everyone in this world.

cameras.name: Cameras shown by
cameras.hint: The module that shows everyone's cameras in this world. Players may choose their own.

camerasPlayer.name: My cameras shown by
camerasPlayer.hint: Shows the cameras your own way on this account, or as the GM chose.

settingsWindow.name: Voice and video settings window
settingsWindow.hint: The module whose window opens for the voice and video settings.

status.reconnecting: Voice and video: connection lost, reconnecting…
status.waitingForGm: Voice and video: waiting for a GM to let you join.
status.gmNeedsSecret: Voice and video: enter the service's key in this browser's module settings, so players can join.
status.noMicrophone: Voice and video: your microphone can't be used. Check this site's microphone permission in the browser.
status.noCamera: Voice and video: your camera can't be used. Check this site's camera permission in the browser.
status.speakingWhileMuted: Voice and video: you're muted, so the others can't hear you.
status.cameraEffectFailed: Voice and video: your camera effect failed, so your camera stays off. Turn the effect off to show your camera.
status.microphoneEffectFailed: Voice and video: a microphone effect failed; your microphone goes on without it.
status.openMic: Voice and video: voice activity can't run, so your microphone is always on. Mute yourself or use push to talk.

ended.joinedElsewhere: Voice and video continued in another tab or window.
ended.kicked: You were removed from the voice and video call.
ended.roomClosed: The voice and video call was closed.
ended.auth: The voice and video service refused to let you in. Ask the GM to check the service settings.
ended.full: The voice and video call is full. Rejoin when someone leaves.
ended.unsupported: This browser can't join the voice and video call.
ended.noService: No voice and video service module is enabled in this world.

status.clientReplaced: Another module replaced Modular A/V's voice and video client. Enable only one voice and video module.
